subject: Align on demo time — DST + rotating-host proposal
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Redwood demo — proposed Wed Sep 1 9:00 AM PT

Hi Vanessa / Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — we'd like a product + technical demo to evaluate Redwood for a latency-sensitive inference use case. Does Wed 1 Sep at 9:00 AM PT work for your team? That time is best for our product and infra leads in Seattle.

A few notes:
- We are on Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) — I realize some of your engineers are in CET/CEST. With DST changes coming in a few weeks we wanted to lock a slot now.
- Ideally the session is 60 minutes: 30m exec overview, 30m deep technical Q&A.
- Please include any prerequisites (sample prompts, dataset requirements).

If Wed morning PT doesn't work, let us know alternatives. We're flexible same-week.

Thanks,
Tom Harris
Senior Product Manager
Cardinal Health

Attachment: (none)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 18:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — proposed Wed Sep 1 9:00 AM PT

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear request. Happy to coordinate. Two quick things up front:

1) Wed Sep 1 9:00 AM PT corresponds to 18:00 CEST for several of our EU engineers. That's late and tends to be hard for in-depth technical sessions. With DST transitions coming in the EU in late October the offsets will change again — safe to lock now, but we want to be mindful of team availability.

2) We can offer two patterns that customers commonly accept: a) a single 60-minute session at the time you proposed (we'll rotate host and have staff join late) or b) a split format: 30-min exec overview at your preferred morning PT slot + a follow-up 60-min technical deep dive scheduled at a CET-friendly time later that week (we can record and provide the recording to attendees).

Possible alternatives (CEST conversions included):
- Option 1 (single meeting): Wed Sep 1, 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST (60 min) — full team joins; will ask engineers to remain later that day.
- Option 2 (split): Wed Sep 1, 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST (30 min exec overview); Thu Sep 2, 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PT (60 min technical deep dive) — recording provided if folks can't make the live technical deep dive.

I'll attach a short agenda and put provisional invites on both slots so you can pick. If you prefer another mix (e.g., move the exec to 11:00 PT to give EU staff a slightly later evening), say so and we'll adjust.

Sooj, can you list any must-have topics for the deep dive (KV cache behavior, batching profiles, model fallbacks)?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-20260901.pdf (agenda stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 18:43:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — proposed Wed Sep 1 9:00 AM PT

Hi Tom, Vanessa — quick technical note and a concise conversion table to make the decision easier.

Priority checklist for the deep dive (we'll cover these if you want a technical session):
- Inference latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) for candidate models
- Batching strategy and how it interacts with short prompt workloads
- KV cache behavior for multi-turn chat and how resume/continue works across sessions
- Fallbacks/routing when Dedicated capacity is saturated
- Security/compliance brief (VPC/private-connect options) — 10m at the end if needed

Time conversions for the proposed windows (Sep 1/2):
- Wed Sep 1, 09:00 PT = Wed Sep 1, 18:00 CEST (Option 1 — single 60m)
- Wed Sep 1, 09:00 PT = Wed Sep 1, 17:00 BST (UK colleagues)
- Thu Sep 2, 15:00 CEST = Thu Sep 2, 06:00 PT (Option 2 — technical deep dive)

If you want the technical deep dive to be more interactive for your infra team, Option 2's 06:00 PT start is early but doable for at least one Redwood engineer; otherwise we can do a recorded deep dive at a CET-friendly time and set up an async Q&A thread.

Let us know must-have scenario examples (throughput, sequence lengths, typical concurrency). I'll bring logs and perf slides tailored to those numbers.

— Soojin Lee
Staff Software Engineer, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa / Soojin — appreciate the options. Two quick answers from our side:

1) We'd prefer the single 60-minute live meeting if possible — our product and infra leads are aligned and 9:00 AM PT is best. If your EU engineers can join at 18:00 CEST, we can keep it as a single meeting.

2) If the late evening is a hard stop for some of your team, we'll accept the split format. In that case we'd like the 30-minute exec overview live at 09:00 PT on Sep 1 and the 60-minute technical deep dive live (or recorded + live QA) at a CET-friendly time later in the week. Please also plan to record the exec overview for any internal follow-up.

Adding Megan Liu (cc) — product lead, will attend the exec portion.

Can you send the calendar invite for the provisional single-slot and the split' option so we can confirm on our end? Also, we use HubSpot to track the deal — happy to have a link in the invite.

Regards,
Tom Harris
